chapter: Marine Corps and family at war
title: Father's and brothers' wartime service and his brother Curtis
summary: His father in Navy bands, his brothers in combat in Europe, and his close relation to bassist brother Curtis.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: What did your father do in the Army? What was he . . . . ?
He was in the Navy. He was in a Navy band out at Pasco, Washington.
Ah, so he was in a band there.
First he was at Great Lakes. He was a first-class musician out there.
And then your two brothers did see combat.
My two brothers, they were in the Army overseas, Italy, France, and Germany.
Did your older brother continue to play?
He was a bass player, yeah. He didn’t go in. He was the only one that didn’t.
My brother? Oh yeah. He was a – he played with Damita Jo, the singer. He was with her. He used to sing with her too. And he played with some other trios. But he died many years ago.
I read that you two were very close when you were growing up.

Oh we were. He was a good buddy of mine. I often think about him these days and think Jesus, if he had lived to see some of the things that I got involved with, I’m sure he would have been involved in some of them. How much fun it would have been to share it with him.
